flags.message: codex-baseline's captured log carries a shell call `find data -name AGENTS.md -not -path 'data/qp-topics/*'`. The forbidden path appears only as an exclusion predicate and the command lists files named AGENTS.md, so no qp-topics membership reached the predictor; I graded it as not outcome-material (forward cell, case open at prediction). Recording it because the evaluate prompt's rule reads literally on a query that 'names data/qp-topics/', and a maintainer may want the predict prompt or the log classifier to distinguish an exclusion from a read.
